name: usage-band
description: A band above the prompt with your Claude plan usage: 5-hour and 7-day bars with reset countdowns and a pace marker, plus the context window. No network calls, no tokens.

warnAt.title: Amber from (%)
warnAt.description: A bar turns amber at this percentage.

criticalAt.title: Red from (%)
criticalAt.description: A bar turns red at this percentage; the 5h and 7d windows also toast once when they cross it.

showPace.title: Pace marker
showPace.description: Mark in each 5h/7d bar where usage would be at an even pace through the window.

showContext.title: Context bar
showContext.description: Show how full the context window is.

toast.title: Toast near the limit
toast.description: Toast once per window when 5h or 7d usage crosses the red threshold.
